From time to time the patient people were ruled by one race or another of despots, cruel and selfish; the most cruel of all, the Hojos.

71181-hitting-the-line.title: Hitting The Line
71181-hitting-the-line.creator: Ralph Henry Barbour
71181-hitting-the-line.description: A book by Ralph Henry Barbour. Two boys alighted from a surface car in front of the big Terminal in New York and dodged their way between dashing taxicabs, honking motor cars and plunging horses to the safety of the broad sidewalk. Each boy carried a suitcase, and each suitcase held, amongst the more or less obliterated labels adorning it, a lozenge-shaped paster of gray paper, bearing, in scarlet, the letters “G. S.,” cunningly angulated to fit the space of the rhombus.

arxiv-2103-03435.title: Implicit Integration of Superpixel Segmentation into Fully Convolutional Networks
arxiv-2103-03435.creator: Teppei Suzuki
arxiv-2103-03435.description: Abstract Superpixels are a useful representation to reduce the complexity of image data. However, to combine superpixels with convolutional neural networks (CNNs) in an end-to-end fashion, one requires extra models to generate superpixels and special operations such as graph convolution.

arxiv-2110-07202.title: Unrolled Variational Bayesian Algorithm for Image Blind Deconvolution
arxiv-2110-07202.creator: Yunshi Huang, Emilie Chouzenoux, and Jean-Christophe Pesquet
arxiv-2110-07202.description: Abstract In this paper, we introduce a variational Bayesian algorithm (VBA) for image blind deconvolution. Our generic framework incorporates smoothness priors on the unknown blur/image and possible affine constraints (e.g., sum to one) on the blur kernel. One of our main contributions is the integration of VBA within a neural network paradigm, following an unrolling methodology.

arxiv-2203-11318.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning and Convex Mean-Variance Optimisation for Portfolio Management
arxiv-2203-11318.creator: Ruan Pretorius, Terence L. van Zyl
arxiv-2203-11318.description: Abstract Traditional portfolio management methods can incorporate specific investor preferences but rely on accurate forecasts of asset returns and covariances. Reinforcement learning (RL) methods do not rely on these explicit forecasts and are better suited for multi-stage decision processes. To address limitations of the evaluated research, experiments were conducted on three markets in different economies with different overall trends.

arxiv-2209-12869.title: Distance Measures for Geometric Graphs
arxiv-2209-12869.creator: Sushovan Majhi, Carola Wenk
arxiv-2209-12869.description: Abstract A geometric graph is a combinatorial graph, endowed with a geometry that is inherited from its embedding in a Euclidean space. Formulation of a meaningful measure of (dis-)similarity in both the combinatorial and geometric structures of two such geometric graphs is a challenging problem in pattern recognition.

arxiv-2304-12344.title: Super-massive black hole wake or bulgeless edge-on galaxy?
arxiv-2304-12344.creator: Jorge Sánchez Almeida, Mireia Montes, Ignacio Trujillo
arxiv-2304-12344.description: Abstract van Dokkum et al. 2023 reported the serendipitous discovery of a thin linear object interpreted as the trail of star-forming regions left behind by a runaway supermassive black hole (SMBH) kicked out from the center of a galaxy. Despite the undeniable interest in the idea, the actual physical interpretation is not devoid of difficulty.

arxiv-2402-07974.description: Abstract Experimental systems with power-law interactions have recently garnered interest as promising platforms for quantum information processing. Such systems are capable of spreading entanglement superballistically and achieving an asymptotic speed-up over locally interacting systems. Recently, protocols developed by Eldredge et al. [Phys. arxiv-2407-06990.title: Segment-Based Interactive Machine Translation for Pre-trained Models
arxiv-2407-06990.creator: Ángel Navarro annamar8@prhlt.upv.es, Francisco Casacuberta fcn@prhlt.upv.es
arxiv-2407-06990.description: Abstract Pre-trained large language models (LLM) are starting to be widely used in many applications. In this work, we explore the use of these models in interactive machine translation (IMT) environments. In particular, we have chosen mBART (multilingual Bidirectional and Auto-Regressive Transformer) and mT5 (multilingual Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer) as the LLMs to perform our experiments.

arxiv-2412-17792.title: Distributed Estimation and Gap-Free Analysis of Canonical Correlations
arxiv-2412-17792.creator: Canyi Chen canyic@umich.edu, Liping Zhu zhu.liping@ruc.edu.cn
arxiv-2412-17792.description: Abstract Massive data analysis calls for distributed algorithms and theories. We design a multi-round distributed algorithm for canonical correlation analysis. We construct principal directions through convex formulation of canonical correlation analysis, and use the shift-and-invert preconditioning iteration to expedite the convergence rate. This distributed algorithm is communication-efficient.

arxiv-2602-16835.title: NeST: Neuron Selective Tuning for LLM Safety
arxiv-2602-16835.creator: Sasha Behrouzi, Lichao Wu, Mohamadreza Rostami, Ahmad-Reza Sadeghi
arxiv-2602-16835.description: Abstract Safety alignment is essential for the responsible deployment of large language models (LLMs). Yet, existing approaches often rely on heavyweight fine-tuning that is costly to update, audit, and maintain across model families. Full fine-tuning incurs substantial computational and storage overhead, while parameter-efficient methods such as LoRA trade efficiency for inconsistent safety gains and sensitivity to design choices.

pmc-11528043.creator: Christopher J F Cameron, Sebastian J H Seager, Fred J Sigworth, Hemant D Tagare, Mark B Gerstein
pmc-11528043.description: Cryo-EM particle identification from micrographs (“picking”) is challenging due to the low signal-to-noise ratio and lack of ground truth for particle locations. State-of-the-art computational algorithms (“pickers”) identify different particle sets, complicating the selection of the best-suited picker for a protein of interest.

pmc-12466702.title: Differences in the Gut Microbiota in Long-Term Infertile Holstein Repeat Breeder Cows and Healthy Fertile Holstein Cows
pmc-12466702.creator: Yui Kitagawa, Sayoko Oishi, Karen Koshimizu, Ryotaro Miura, Seizo Hamano, Hisataka Iwata, Koumei Shirasuna
pmc-12466702.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Simple SummaryThe influence of the gut microbiota on reproductive function has garnered scientific attention. This study investigated the relationship between reproductive performance and gut microbiota in Holstein cows, depending on reproductive attempts and subsequent pregnancy outcomes. Fecal samples were collected from Holstein cows at the time of ovulation and classified into four groups: normal pregnancy, normal open, repeat breeder (RB) pregnancy, and RB open.

pmc-12585449.title: Are these crystals isostructural? Symmetry requirements, extent of difference, and likeness of supramolecular interactions
pmc-12585449.creator: Petra Bombicz
pmc-12585449.description: The intentional design of crystalline materials, the fine-tuning of physical and chemical properties by slight chemical alterations - crystal engineering - requires understanding of solid-state assembly including supramolecular interactions and isostructurality. The balance of spatial requirements and electrostatic effects ultimately determines the molecular arrangement.

pmc-13006639.title: Characterization of a novel composite ICE in Streptococcus agalactiae conferring resistance to macrolides [erm(TR)] and cadmium (cadA)
pmc-13006639.creator: Sida Yi, Chunli Shi, Liufan Yin, Xing Xu, Xueliang Wang
pmc-13006639.description: BackgroundMacrolide resistance genes (erm and mef families) and heavy metal resistance genes (cadA) are increasingly disseminated among streptococci via diverse mobile genetic elements.MethodsThrough whole-genome sequencing of 16 Streptococcus agalactiae isolates resistant to both erythromycin and clindamycin, we identified 19 integrative and conjugative elements (ICEs), a type of self-transfer genetic elements, conferring antibiotic resistance.

pmc-13017945.title: Eye movement abnormalities in autism spectrum disorder and prodromal psychosis: a review of overlaps and biomarkers
pmc-13017945.creator: Ethan Terman, Lior Sanilevich, Christian Zaballos
pmc-13017945.description: ObjectivesDifferentiating prodromal psychosis from autism spectrum disorder (ASD) during adolescence remains a major clinical challenge due to overlapping behavioral and cognitive features and the absence of reliable biological markers. This review synthesizes evidence on eye tracking and oculomotor abnormalities to evaluate their potential utility as objective biomarkers for distinguishing ASD, clinical high-risk (CHR) states, and prodromal psychosis in adolescent populations.

pmc-13068468.title: Surgical Timing and Rehabilitation (STaR) for Multiple Ligament Knee Injuries
pmc-13068468.creator: James J. Irrgang, Andrew D. Lynch, Charity G. Patterson, Alexandra B. Gil, Travis C. Burns, Megan Dalzell, Al M.J. Getgood, Christopher D. Harner, Bruce A. Levy, Brett D. Owens, Kathleen M. Poploski, Dustin L. Richter, Robert C. Schenck, Brian R. Waterman, Daniel B. Whelan, Volker Musahl, Robert Arc
pmc-13068468.description: Multiple ligament knee injuries (MLKIs) often result in persistent pain, residual disability including post-traumatic osteoarthritis, and high healthcare costs. Although nonrandomized and retrospective research supports operative management, evidence informing the optimal timing of MLKI surgery and subsequent rehabilitation is lacking. In addition, return to preinjury military duty, work, and sports after MLKI is poorly understood.

pmc-13099882.title: On the interface between linguistics, computer science and psychiatry: analyzing textual key-factors affecting BERT-based classification of schizophrenia in social media texts
pmc-13099882.creator: J. V. Miranda e Silva, C. Rodrigues, E. Vital Brazil
pmc-13099882.description: IntroductionThis paper investigates language impairments in schizophrenia (SZ) by analyzing the decision-making process of a transformer-based model in discriminating between texts produced by persons with SZ and persons without SZ. By doing so, we integrate insights from language-centered investigations with computational approaches.

pmc-13448347.title: Anatomical Atlas and Three-Dimensional Musculoskeletal Model of the Flight Apparatus in the Southern Screamer (Anseriformes: Chauna torquata)
pmc-13448347.creator: Klara Widrig, Aiden Starry, Helen F James
pmc-13448347.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). SynopsisThe three bird species within the family Anhimidae (screamers) are of great interest to the big picture of avian evolution due to both their phylogenetic position and their unusual combination of features. As screamers are early diverging members of Anseriformes (waterfowl), which itself is an early diverging clade within the extant bird radiation, their anatomy may help shed light on that of the common ancestor of both Anseriformes and crown-group birds as a whole.

pmc-13477723.title: Mpox in a Neonate: A Case Report of a 14-day-old Baby in Nigeria
pmc-13477723.creator: Ebenovbe Idemudia, Ayebo Evawere Sadoh
pmc-13477723.description: Background:Human mpox (HMPX) is a zoonotic infection caused by the Monkeypox Virus (MPXV), with commonly reported routes of transmission being contact with infected wildlife, humans, and fomites. More data is needed to establish the frequency of transmission from asymptomatic carriers and from mother to child.Initially confined to 10 West and Central African countries, mpox assumed a global dimension in 2022.

pmc-13657774.title: Habitat-based ultrasound radiomics for preoperative prediction of axillary lymph node metastasis in breast cancer: a two-center study
pmc-13657774.creator: Zimeng Fang, Xiaoyu Yan, Yunyun Zhan, Yu Bi, Xiabi Wu, Mingdi Fang, Yufan Zhang, Jiajia Wang, Mei Peng
pmc-13657774.description: BackgroundAccurate preoperative prediction of axillary lymph node metastasis (ALNM) remains challenging. This study investigates whether habitat-based ultrasound radiomics of suspicious axillary lymph nodes can predict preoperative ALNM in patients with breast cancer.MethodsThis retrospective two-center study included 416 breast cancer patients with suspicious axillary lymph nodes and pathologically confirmed nodal status.

uslaw-usc-t21-s21.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t21-s21.description: United States Code, Title 21 (Food And Drugs); Chapter 1 (Adulterated Or Misbranded Foods Or Drugs); Subchapter II (Miscellaneous Provisions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel.
